Save the Date Cookie & Cocoa Crawl

Sweet Stops, Warm Cocoa, Holiday Fun

Description

Saturday, December 5, 2026
10:00 AM – 3:00 PM

Kick off the holiday season with a festive Cookie & Cocoa Crawl in Historic Downtown Clarksville! Purchase your ticket, then stroll through charming downtown, sip warm cocoa, and collect a delicious holiday cookie at participating businesses along the way.

Gather your family and friends, enjoy the sights and sounds of the season, and make sweet holiday memories—all while supporting Historic Downtown Clarksville.

Proceeds from this ticketed event benefit Historic Downtown Clarksville.

Ticket information and participating businesses coming soon!
